title: Universal Mother-Wavelet Decomposition of the Jacobi-Riemann Kernel, Smooth Jacobi-Sinh Shells, and Explicit Saddle-Point Remainder Bounds for Riemann's Xi-Function
description: Paper V of the series on the Transverse Wronskian of Riemann's Xi-Function. Establishes the universal mother-wavelet log-shift dilation of the Jacobi-Riemann kernel, exact polynomial cancellation |(1-s)(-s)| = |s(s-1)| in the bilateral Laplace-Mellin transform, the 3-line reflection-ellipse proof of W_{1,1}(d,t) > 0, the Symmetric Branch-Damping Inequality across all active Riemann-Siegel modes, the 2D Wigner phase-space shift and smooth Jacobi-Sinh shell elimination of the u = 0 odd-derivative kink, the non-oscillatory cubic-logarithmic Stieltjes diagonal expansion with O(t^{-3/2}) boundary mode self-damping, and explicit incomplete-Gamma and two-dimensional Gabcke-Olver saddle-point remainder envelopes.
